capture: Genuine browser viewport screenshots, 1280 × 720. Observations describe the inspected states, not a full audit of each site. Reference assets remain attributed research material and are not NUMEK assets.

references.title: AI in Design Report 2026
references.creator: ++hellohello / Designer Fund
references.observation: A shallow media band gives way to enormous, tightly spaced type. Smaller copy occupies a separate left zone. The Tools chapter keeps the same navigation and changes to a full orange opening before the analytical content. Hierarchy survives the page transition.
references.motion: The masthead stays present while scrolling; the chapter uses the same reading framework. Captured home and chapter states show the change in scale and color. These are state captures, not a timing-accurate recording.
references.transfer: Make DataTrust reports feel authored: strong entry, visible reading structure, explicit chart populations. Use original report compositions and a distinct palette.
references.status: Live home, scroll and Tools chapter inspected; creator case study read. Individual Awwwards entry inspected after a slow modal load.

references.title: Micro
references.creator: Reform Collective
references.observation: The hero places large copy low on a framed landscape. A later product section gives the application a large, centered stage with a small mode selector above it. Scale and framing do more work than a list of features.
references.motion: Scrolling progresses from environment and type to a large product screen, then to a more theatrical scene. The top navigation remains available. Some embedded media reported playback limitations, so no claim is made about complete video sequences.
references.transfer: Give a real analytical screen enough area to read; choreograph one deliberate reveal. Scenic landscape, chrome spheres and the email product metaphor stay with Micro.
references.status: Live hero, product section and later reveal inspected; creator case study read.

references.title: Hyperbolic
references.creator: Studio Freight
references.observation: The light site pairs generous grotesk typography with violet line drawings and shaped boundaries. The detailed subject remains recognizable as the treatment changes. Audience explanations sit next to the visual rather than competing with it.
references.motion: Scrolling brings the large line-art subject alongside an ordered audience section. Creator-case videos were not fully playable here; the visual pairing and live scroll states were inspected.
references.transfer: Build one NUMEK graphic vocabulary from actual rows, distributions and evidence references, then carry it across scales. Hardware illustration and Hyperbolic’s marks are not transferred.
references.status: Live development site and creator case study inspected.

references.title: Every Line in Hamilton
references.creator: Shirley Wu / The Pudding
references.observation: A single population of colored marks begins as a recognizable composition and then opens out around the explanatory text. The page explicitly explains what a mark represents before introducing deeper exploration.
references.motion: Scrolling changes the marks’ arrangement while the narrative advances. The evidence captured here covers the introduction and encoding explanation; the later filter combinations were not exercised.
references.transfer: Introduce one real DataTrust population, explain its encoding, then reveal the exact finding and denominator. No decorative particle field, musical identity or lyric content is reused.
references.status: Live opening, narrative and encoding transition inspected; later filters not tested.

references.title: ART+TECH Report 2023
references.creator: MoreSleep / ART+TECH Report
references.observation: Condensed sans and contrasting serif numerals make distinct jobs of titles and values. The first finding has a strong left narrative and a large, bounded chart on the right. The report has an identity without giving up labeled quantities.
references.motion: Clicking the first finding navigates down the document. Persistent navigation survives the blue-to-white change; selected chapter and chart acquire a mint accent. Captured start and settled destination.
references.transfer: Make the finding the section’s organizing unit; pair interpretation with a chart that can be read. Avoid copying the capsule composition or mixed-font title treatment.
references.status: Live opening and first finding inspected; Awwwards project description read.

references.title: LPAS
references.creator: Studio Naam
references.observation: The first screen uses almost the whole viewport for its subject. Market panels subsequently move across the view with a consistent image/text split. Different contents share a clear spatial rhythm rather than a repeated small-card grid.
references.motion: The Explore control begins a horizontal panel transition. Further scrolling exposes neighboring panels while retaining a sliver of the previous one. Menu and identity stay anchored.
references.transfer: Use adjacent analytical panes to establish comparison and continuity. Keep application scrolling conventional; adapt panel transitions only where they clarify a marketing story.
references.status: Live hero, Explore control and market-panel scroll inspected. Creator URL retained for attribution; no claim of visual inspection of that case-study page.

references.title: Experiment Space
references.creator: Obys
references.observation: Huge centered typography acts as a stable horizon while smaller work samples occupy the foreground at different depths. Thin rules and small perimeter navigation preserve orientation despite the dramatic scale contrast.
references.motion: The live spatial scene was observed; drag behavior and every arrangement were not tested. A still cannot establish its timing or interaction quality.
references.transfer: Use strong changes in scale to focus attention on an actual field or finding. Application evidence remains flat and aligned; the 3D gallery is not a NUMEK interface.
references.status: Live initial scene inspected; deeper interaction not tested.

references.title: Siena Film Foundation
references.creator: Niccolò Miranda
references.observation: After entry, one large subject dominates a rounded viewport while title, metadata and project navigation remain in purposeful zones. The typography and framing establish an unusually coherent identity.
references.motion: Dismissed instructions, entered, and scrolled. A delayed reveal eventually exposed the stacked project presentation. Film playback and the full drag experience were not verified.
references.transfer: Give the primary analytical artifact a clear stage and stable metadata. Entry gates, film-program language and ticket styling would add friction to DataTrust and are not proposed.
references.status: Entry and project scene inspected after loading delay; project detail pages not inspected.

references.title: Year in Review 2025
references.creator: Unseen Studio
references.observation: A textured typographic opening gives way to a pale neighboring chapter. Large chronological words, media and small navigational cues operate at sharply different scales.
references.motion: After a prolonged loader, the live scene became available. One scroll moved the opening left as January entered from the right. Later months were not visually inspected.
references.transfer: Change the pace between a concentrated introduction and a clear explanation. Retain only that sequencing principle; no ASCII field or chronological theatre is proposed.
references.status: Opening and one panel transition inspected; long initial loading delay.

references.title: Linear
references.creator: Linear · secondary product reference
references.observation: A restrained heading gives way to a large application with closely aligned labels, fine separators and a contextual detail pane. The public page allows the software to carry much of its own explanation.
references.motion: Scrolled from the heading into the embedded product view. App account workflows were not tested. Background demo content changed during observation.
references.transfer: Use readable software density and clear contextual panels as a quality reference. Do not transfer agent functionality, collaboration claims or Linear’s navigation structure wholesale.
references.status: Public hero and product demo inspected; no account access.

accessNotes: The Awwwards data-visualization gallery initially timed out but later loaded in the browser; its individual AI in Design entry was then inspected. The web text tool could not fetch the gallery.
Praetorian Aeronautics and Cartier 365 were read through award/creator descriptions only. They are not visual influences claimed by these proposals.
References from the wider supplied library that are not listed above were not inspected or used as claimed influences.
No native browser-recording capability was exposed. Paired genuine captures provide interaction-state evidence; they do not reproduce continuous motion or timing.
